messages.task:
You are a highly-skilled financial analyst.

Scenario background (excerpted from company filings – tables redacted):
warfighter information network-tactical (WIN-T); command, control, battle management and communications (C2BMC); and TWIC).
Partially offsetting the decreases were higher net sales of approximately $140 million from QTC, which was acquired early in the fourth quarter of 2011; and about $65 million from increased activity on numerous other programs, primarily federal cyber-security programs and PTDS operational support.
IS&GS 2019 operating profit for 2012 decreased $66 million, or 8 %, compared to 2011.
The decrease was attributable to lower operating profit of approximately $50 million due to the favourable impact of the ODIN contract completion in 2011; about $25 million due to an increase in reserves for performance issues related to an international airborne-surveillance system in 2012; and approximately $20 million due to lower volume on certain programs (primarily C2BMC and WIN-T).
Partially offsetting the decreases was an increase in operating profit due to higher risk retirements of approximately $15 million from the TWIC program; and about $10 million due to increased activity on numerous other programs, primarily federal cyber-security programs and PTDS operational support.
Operating profit for the JTRS program was comparable as a decrease in volume was offset by a decrease in reserves.
Adjustments not related to volume, including net profit booking-rate adjustments and other matters described above, were approximately $20 million higher for 2012 compared to 2011.
Backlog decreased in 2013 compared to 2012 primarily due to lower orders on several programs (such as ERAM and NGI), higher sales on certain programs (the National Science Foundation Antarctic support and the DISA GSM-O), and declining activities on several smaller programs primarily due to the continued downturn in federal information-technology budgets.
Backlog decreased in 2012 compared to 2011 primarily due to the substantial completion of various programs in 2011 (primarily ODIN, U.K. Census, and JTRS).
Trends: we expect IS&GS 2019 net sales to decline in 2014 in the high-single-digit percentage range as compared to 2013 primarily due to the continued downturn in federal information-technology budgets. Operating profit is also expected to decline in 2014 in the high-single-digit percentage range consistent with the expected decline in net sales, resulting in margins that are comparable with 2013 results.
Missiles and Fire Control (MFC) provides air and missile-defence systems; tactical missiles and air-to-ground precision-strike weapon systems; logistics and other technical services; fire-control systems; mission-operations support, readiness, engineering support and integration services; and manned and unmanned ground vehicles.
MFC’s major programmes include PAC-3, THAAD, Multiple Launch Rocket System, Hellfire, Joint Air-to-Surface Standoff Missile (JASSM), Javelin, Apache fire-control system (Apache), Sniper AE, Low Altitude Navigation and Targeting Infrared for Night (LANTIRN AE), and SOF CLSS.

Available tools (use them as needed – each call is free):
• list_business_segments() -> List[str]
  Return all segment names.
• get_segment_id_by_name(segment_name: str) -> int
  Map a business-segment name to its internal ID.
• list_fiscal_years_for_segment(segment_id: int, start_year: int | None = None, end_year: int | None = None) -> List[int]
  List fiscal years with data for a given segment.
• get_operating_margin(segment_id: int, fiscal_year: int) -> float
  Get the operating-margin percentage for one segment/year pair.
• get_net_sales(segment_id: int, fiscal_year: int) -> float
  Retrieve net sales (millions USD).
• get_backlog(segment_id: int, fiscal_year: int) -> float
  Retrieve year-end backlog (millions USD).
• get_operating_margins_bulk(segment_id: int, years: List[int]) -> List[float]
  Convenience wrapper that returns a list of margins for several years.
• average(values: List[float]) -> float
  Compute the arithmetic mean of a non-empty list.
• random_financial_tip() -> str
  Returns a random finance tip (purely informational).

Question you must answer:
What was the average operating margin for MFC from 2011 through 2013?  Provide the number rounded to one decimal place followed by the percent sign (e.g. "12.3%”).

Think step-by-step, decide which tools you need, call them, and state the final answer clearly.
